description: This file defines the interface OpenmrsDataDAO in the OpenMRS project, specifying generic database operations for data entities extending BaseOpenmrsData, including retrieving lists of entities with optional voided filters and pagination.

classes.name: OpenmrsDataDAO
classes.description: A generic Data Access Object interface for OpenMRS data entities extending BaseOpenmrsData, supporting retrieval operations with filters for voided status and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of persistents of the specified type, optionally including voided records.

methods.name: getAllCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of persistents, optionally including voided records.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of persistents of the specified type, optionally including voided records.
